description: GFA boresight geometry per camera serial: sep_deg = chip centre to boresight, theta_deg = boresight direction in the camera pixel frame (+x towards +y).
method: boresight of each set = centre of the camera ring; per camera the median over the state-A sets of a field, then the mean over fields (theta circular), so every field counts once. Solutions: solve-field on the matched-filter star lists (SIP order 2).
cameras_gaia_method: as 'cameras', on the Gaia-refit chip solutions (fixed distortion of gfa_distortion.json + linear fit to Gaia DR3 at the epoch); used for frames with GFAREFIT = T

pattern.description: Chip centre per camera in focal-plane mm about the ring centre (design frame) and the planner mapping sky -> focal plane (gnomonic about the field centre, radial factor 1 + k1 r^2 + k2 r^4 + k3 r^6, then matrix [mm/rad]). GFA.pointing.pattern_centre fits shift, rotation and scale of the chip centres to it; the boresight is the origin.
pattern.method: state-A five-camera sets, Gaia-refit (allpl) chip centres: per set the chip positions about the ring centre turned and scaled onto the design pattern, then averaged
